entries.rationale: The ONE live suite (LIVE-SUITE): third-party MCP servers from the local cache and the hosted endpoints under the root policy's declared live consent. Run by `npm run test:live` only, which refuses at load without the consent; never part of the hermetic run, which has no skips by design.

The ONE live suite (LIVE-SUITE): a real chat completion against an ENVIRONMENT-DECLARED provider (HARNESS_SMOKE_BASE_URL, HARNESS_SMOKE_MODEL, HARNESS_API_KEY) under the root policy's declared live consent. Run by `npm run test:live` only, which refuses at load without the consent or the provider; its hermetic half (the typed refusals) stays in test/runtime/makora-smoke.test.ts.
